title: The ending's oath-tracking line says 'You swore to burn the hollows for the Regent, then rested one instead' — but I never chose a pure 'rest' resolution anywhere (I bargained twice, burned once). This is the same rest/bargain conflation bug bleeding into the ending's own summary text.
